description: A foundation’s public GrantCue profile, from the latest Form 990-PF, or Form 990 Schedule I for community foundations and other grantmaking charities: giving totals, typical and median grant, giving by year, where it gives, the 25 largest grants its latest filings report, and for a 990-PF filer how to apply. For a Form 990 funder: its kind, the latest tax year, totals and the top 10 recipients (yearly totals); Form 990 does not say whether it accepts applications. Only foundations with a public profile, and funders with a Schedule I return, are found. It never returns the full list of reported grants.

ein.description: The foundation’s EIN, with or without the dash.

title: Get a foundation
